title: How We Met a Listener: Jessica [SPOILER Alert!]

sentences.en: Hey everybody, Craig Thomas here, Josh Radner.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是克雷格·托马斯，这位是乔什·雷德纳。

sentences.en: We just wanted to start off this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想在这一集一开始就说明一下。

sentences.en: It's a very special episode of the podcaSt. It is rife with spoilers for the end of the series and to be like the entire sort of forward jumping through the entire series,
sentences.zh: 这是本播客一个非常特殊的特别节目。它充满了剧透，涉及剧集大结局，而且可以说是向前跨越了整部剧集的全部内容，

sentences.en: which we do not do week to week, episode to episode in our recap episodes.
sentences.zh: 这可不是我们在常规回顾节目中每周、每集会做的事情。

sentences.en: This is definitely not that.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是那种节目。

sentences.en: It is big spoilers.
sentences.zh: 这里面有重大剧透。

sentences.en: It is how the series ends.
sentences.zh: 内容直接涉及剧集将如何结局。

sentences.en: It is major spoilers.
sentences.zh: 这是极其重大的剧透。

sentences.en: Let's salute it.
sentences.zh: 让我们向它致敬。

sentences.en: And we will salute it so that you will recognize that if you don't want to hear major spoilers, please don't listen to this one.
sentences.zh: 我们这样郑重其事，是为了让大家明白，如果你不想听到重大剧透，请千万不要听这一集。

sentences.en: But if you do want to hear that and you do know where we go with the series, please do listen to this one because as you're going to hear,
sentences.zh: 但如果你确实想听，而且你也知道我们这剧最终走向何方，请务必听这一集，因为正如你即将听到的那样，

sentences.en: it's really one of the most special episodes of this podcast that we've ever done.
sentences.zh: 这真的是我们做过的最特别、最有意义的播客节目之一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And also, we just wanted to, if you're feeling particularly sensitive right now, you have every reason to.
sentences.zh: 另外，我们只是想说，如果你现在感觉特别脆弱敏感，你的心情完全可以理解。

sentences.en: The world is a very tough place.
sentences.zh: 这个世界是个非常艰难的地方。

sentences.en: This episode does go very deeply into loss and grief and death.
sentences.zh: 这一集确实非常深刻地探讨了失去、悲伤和死亡。

sentences.en: So if this isn't where you are right now, also feel free to skip it and come back to it another time.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你现在的情绪不适合听这些，也请随意跳过，改天再来听。

sentences.en: But we do think this is an incredibly special, wonderful episode of How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 但我们真心觉得，这是《老爸老妈的浪漫史幕后》中极其特别、绝妙的一集。

sentences.en: And we're really happy you're here.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很高兴你能来收听。

sentences.en: Welcome to a very special edition of How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《老爸老妈的浪漫史幕后》的特别版节目。

sentences.en: I'm Josh Radner.
sentences.zh: 我是乔什·雷德纳。

sentences.en: I'm joined by my co-host and dear friend, Craig Thomas.
sentences.zh: 和我一起主持的是我的搭档兼挚友克雷格·托马斯。

sentences.en: Hi, Craig.
sentences.zh: 嗨，克雷格。

sentences.en: Hey, Josh.
sentences.zh: 嗨，乔什。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So regular listeners of this podcast will know that one of the things, one of our favorite things about the show is hearing from fans, longtime viewers, new viewers even.
sentences.zh: 本播客的忠实听众都会知道，我们节目最喜欢的事情之一，就是听粉丝、老观众甚至新观众分享他们的心声。

sentences.en: Uh, but we have a thing on, uh, on the website, uh, how we made your mother.com where you can go, uh, we'll tell you how to do it.
sentences.zh: 呃，我们在那个网站上，呃，howwemakeyourmother.com 上有个板块，你可以去那儿，呃，我们会告诉你怎么操作。

sentences.en: You can go to contact and you can either send us a voice note or send us a written note.
sentences.zh: 你可以点击“联系我们”，然后给我们发送一条语音留言或者文字留言。

sentences.en: And we, uh, we, we start every show, most shows with a voice note we've received.
sentences.zh: 我们，呃，我们每期节目开头，大多数节目都会播放一条我们收到的语音留言。

sentences.en: And, uh, it's just been this very special way that we have learned how the show has affected people, how it's continued to affect people, change their lives,
sentences.zh: 呃，这已经成为一种非常特殊的方式，让我们了解到这部剧是如何影响人们的，它是如何继续影响人们、改变他们的人生，

sentences.en: when they discovered it, what it meant to them, continues to mean to them.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是什么时候发现这部剧的，它对他们意味着什么，并且过去和现在都意味着什么。

sentences.en: Um, and about a year ago, we, one of the earliest, uh, voice notes we received right after the show premiered was from a woman named Jessica who shared, uh, uh,
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约一年前，我们在节目开播后不久收到最早的语音留言之一，来自一位名叫杰西卡的女士，她跟我们分享了，呃，呃，

sentences.en: with us her story about how I met your mother.
sentences.zh: 她与《老爸老妈的浪漫史》的故事。

sentences.en: Um, and we were absolutely bowled over by this note.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们被这条留言深深地震撼了。

sentences.en: So bowled over that we wanted to create a whole episode, uh, around this note.
sentences.zh: 震撼到我们想要围绕这条留言制作整整一期节目。

sentences.en: And, uh, we wanted to invite Jessica onto the show.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我们想邀请杰西卡来到节目中。

sentences.en: She's here with us right now, but we're not going to introduce her just yet.
sentences.zh: 她现在就和我们在一起，但我们先不急着介绍她。

sentences.en: We want to, uh, we want to actually play you the note we received.
sentences.zh: 我们想，呃，我们其实想先播放一下我们收到的那条留言。

sentences.en: And again, this is a, a, a, a full on bubble wrapped spoiler alert episode in terms of if you have not seen the finale,
sentences.zh: 再次提醒，这是一期全方位包裹在泡沫里的防剧透警报节目，如果你还没看过大结局，

sentences.en: if you've not gotten all the way to the end of the series and you don't want to spoil this, don't listen to this episode for a while.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有把整部剧看到最后，又不想被剧透，那就先别听这一集。

sentences.en: We're breaking every rule today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天打破了所有常规。

sentences.en: We're pretty good about not jumping ahead and giving huge series spoilers.
sentences.zh: 我们在克制剧透、不提前剧透整部剧这方面一直做得挺好的。

sentences.en: Today's the huge exception to that rule.
sentences.zh: 但今天是个极大的例外。

sentences.en: So if you don't want to hear huge spoilers, turn it off now.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不想听到巨大的剧透，现在就关掉吧。

sentences.en: But otherwise, please listen, if you know where the series ends up, because, uh, we want you to hear this.
sentences.zh: 但如果你知道本剧的结局会走向何方，请务必收听，因为，呃，我们希望你听到这些。

sentences.en: And in a show that really honors nonlinear narrative, I feel like we're doing that here today.
sentences.zh: 而且在一部真正推崇非线性叙事的剧中，我觉得我们今天就是在这样做。

sentences.en: Huge flash forward right now.
sentences.zh: 现在是一次超级大闪回。

sentences.en: Huge flash forward.
sentences.zh: 超级大闪回。

sentences.en: In the podcast timeline.
sentences.zh: 在播客的时间线里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, um, so again, we received this note from, uh, Jessica.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，所以再次感谢，我们收到了来自杰西卡的这条留言。

sentences.en: We were so moved by it.
sentences.zh: 我们为之深受感动。

sentences.en: We've been sitting with this note for, uh, about a year.
sentences.zh: 这条留言我们保存了，嗯，大约有一年时间。

sentences.en: Um, and we knew we wanted to do something special with it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且我们知道我们想用它来做点特别的事情。

sentences.en: So that's, this whole episode is kind of centered around that.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是，这一整集基本上都是围绕这个展开的。

sentences.en: But, but before we, uh, launch into it, we're just going to play you the note.
sentences.zh: 但是，在我们开始之前，嗯，我们先放这段留言给大家听听。

sentences.en: So this is the note we received, the voice note we received one year ago.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们收到的留言，一年前收到的语音留言。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Jessica.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫杰西卡。

sentences.en: I live in Brooklyn, New York.
sentences.zh: 我住在纽约布鲁克林。

sentences.en: How I met your mother has meant a lot of things to me over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，《老爸老妈浪漫史》对我有很重大的意义。

sentences.en: And recently came back into my life through circumstances I've been in.
sentences.zh: 最近由于我经历的一些情况，它又回到了我的生活中。

sentences.en: Um, when I started watching How I Met Your Mother, it was in 2005 when it aired.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我开始看《老爸老妈浪漫史》的时候，是2005年它刚开播的时候。

sentences.en: I had just moved to New York a year prior.
sentences.zh: 我刚好在它开播前一年搬到纽约。

sentences.en: I had a group of friends I hung out with, sometimes in bars.
sentences.zh: 我有一群一起闲逛的朋友，有时会去酒吧。

sentences.en: I was perpetually single and trying to find that special person.
sentences.zh: 我一直单身，努力寻找那个特别的人。

sentences.en: Imagining I'd meet them in that typical way that you imagine in the movies where someone drops their groceries and you both lean down to pick them up and make that eye contact.
sentences.zh: 想象着会像电影里那样典型的场景遇到他：某人掉了杂货，你们俩同时弯腰去捡，然后来了个眼神接触。

sentences.en: Um, fast forward, um, fast forward a lot of mishap dating that really related to that show to me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，快进，嗯，快进到许多乱七八糟的约会，这真的和那部剧很有共鸣。

sentences.en: Um, and it's amazing this podcast came up when it did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且很神奇的是，这个播客偏偏在这个时候推出了。

sentences.en: So I got married when I was in my mid thirties.
sentences.zh: 所以我三十岁出头的时候结婚了。

sentences.en: I had a child of 39 with an amazing guy that I met in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 我在39岁时生下了一个孩子，孩子的父亲我在布鲁克林遇到的一位了不起的男士。

sentences.en: Um, and we built a family together.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们一起建立了一个家庭。

sentences.en: We were together for eight years and married for five.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起八年，结婚五年。

sentences.en: Um, my husband was born with a congenital heart defect.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我丈夫天生患有先天性心脏病。

sentences.en: Um, and he lived his life with this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他带着这个病生活了很长时间。

sentences.en: I had to go in the hospital a few times in his life, but always did well.
sentences.zh: 在他的一生中，我陪他进过几次医院，但情况一直都挺好。

sentences.en: Um, and, um, he almost got a heart transplant recently because he got very sick at the end of December, right after Christmas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，嗯，他最近差点做成心脏移植，因为他在12月底，也就是圣诞节后不久，病得很重。

sentences.en: Um, and, um, and, uh, came home for a bit, had to go back to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，嗯，嗯，回家了一会儿，又不得不回医院。

sentences.en: It was a whirlwind of things.
sentences.zh: 那真是一阵兵荒马乱。

sentences.en: And then, um, he didn't qualify for the heart transplant.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，他不符合心脏移植的条件。

sentences.en: And, um, that was very hard.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，那真的很难熬。

sentences.en: Um, so we had to make a decision as a family that he was going to die.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我们全家不得不做出一个决定，他要去世了。

sentences.en: And we did that.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做了。

sentences.en: And he went to palliative care, which is essentially care instead of treatment and later to hospice.
sentences.zh: 他去了姑息治疗，本质上是重在关怀而非治疗，后来又转入了临终关怀医院。

sentences.en: And in the last hospital he went to, which was in Brooklyn, which was closer to home, as I was walking home from visiting him one day, um, he, I realized, oh my God,
sentences.zh: 在他去的最后一家医院，在布鲁克林，离家更近一些，有一天我从他那儿探病走回家的路上，嗯，他，我突然意识到，天哪，

sentences.en: Ted's wife died.
sentences.zh: 特德的妻子死了。

sentences.en: And the ending of the show that used to make me so confused sometimes because I loved her similiati and I loved the relationship that her and Ted had.
sentences.zh: 而这部剧的结局，以前有时会让我感到很困惑，因为我喜欢她，也喜欢她和特德之间的关系。

sentences.en: And I realized in that moment that that was the point is that you were supposed to love her and want them to be together forever, but it just wasn't meant to be,
sentences.zh: 我在那一刻意识到，重点就在于你应该爱她，希望他们永远在一起，但事与愿违，

sentences.en: but you can have more than one love in your life.
sentences.zh: 不过你的人生中可以拥不止一份爱。

sentences.en: My husband died on March 9th, the day before your podcast aired.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫在3月9日去世，就在你们播客播出前一天。

sentences.en: And I just found it so appropriate and so crazy.
sentences.zh: 我只觉得这一切太契合、太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The timing of it all.
sentences.zh: 这一切的时机。

sentences.en: Um, How You Met Your Mother is a very important show to me and it's paralleled my life in some ways, but it's also just very humorous and funny and silly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，《老爸老妈浪漫史》对我来说是一部非常重要的剧，它在某些方面与我的人生轨迹不谋而合，但它同时也很幽默、有趣、搞笑。

sentences.en: I, and I've always been rooting for it all the time, but it's also very grounding.
sentences.zh: 我，我一直都在为它加油，但它也很接地气。

sentences.en: It's a grounding show and it's real.
sentences.zh: 这是一部很接地气的剧，而且很真实。

sentences.en: People were so upset about the ending, but that ending was real because I felt it.
sentences.zh: 人们对结局很不满，但那个结局是真实的，因为我亲身体会到了。

sentences.en: Um, and I thank you for being there for me right after my husband's death, because this podcast is really, really touching me in a deep way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你们在我丈夫去世后陪伴着我，因为这个播客真的深深地触动了我。

sentences.en: And thank you, Josh, for opening back up to this world, because that means a lot to me, too.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你，乔许，重新向这个世界敞开心扉，因为这对我也意义重大。

sentences.en: And I think you're great.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: So, um, that was a note from Jessica.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，以上就是杰西卡的留言。

sentences.en: We're all, um, we're all moved over here and, uh, you can understand, I'm sure, why that note affected us the way it did and why it stayed with us.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都，嗯，我们所有人都搬到这边来了，而且，呃，我想你一定能理解为什么那条留言对我们的触动那么深，为什么让我们久久难忘。

sentences.en: And, um, yeah, Jessica's here.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，对，杰西卡也来了。

sentences.en: We just really want to welcome her to the show.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很想欢迎她来到节目中。

sentences.en: Hi, Jessica.
sentences.zh: 嗨，杰西卡。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi, Jessica.
sentences.zh: 嗨，杰西卡。

sentences.en: Welcome to How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《老爸老妈的浪漫史》幕后揭秘。

sentences.en: We're good.
sentences.zh: 我们很好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We're so happy you're here.
sentences.zh: 我们太高兴你能来了。

sentences.en: And we're so happy that...
sentences.zh: 而且我们也非常高兴……

sentences.en: I'm happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴能来。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're so happy you left us that note.
sentences.zh: 对，我们太高兴你给我们留了那条语音了。

sentences.en: And, um, I'm curious, what, uh, what's it like to hear, to hear that back?
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我很好奇，把、呃，把这段话再听一遍是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Like, like, um, do you feel like you said, I feel like you said exactly what you needed to say, but do you feel that you really captured what, what you felt?
sentences.zh: 就、就像，嗯，你觉得自己当时说的话，我觉得你是不是说出了你最想表达的，但你觉得它真的捕捉到了你当时的心情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I do, because I, I didn't write anything down.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得是的，因为我、我什么都没打草稿。

sentences.en: I, I knew that, um, so, so I sent that note only a few weeks after my husband passed away, like, in April.
sentences.zh: 我、我知道，嗯，所以、所以我发那条留言是在我丈夫去世几周后，大概在四月份。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, um, I really felt like I needed to share a little bit of my story because the podcast helped me so much.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我真的觉得我需要分享一点我的故事，因为这个播客对我帮助太大了。

sentences.en: Like, like, the fact that it was airing, like, on March 10th, like, I literally went, oh, my God, I have something to, like, look forward to.
sentences.zh: 比如、比如，它播出的那天，也就是3月10日，我当时真的觉得，天哪，我终于有、有什么可以期待的事情了。

sentences.en: I have something to be excited about.
sentences.zh: 我有了可以感到兴奋的事。

sentences.en: Um, and the fact that you can leave voice messages and do that kind of thing made me very, so, yeah, I feel like it's very, um, authentic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且你们能接收语音留言并做那种事，让我觉得非常、所以，对，我觉得这非常、嗯，真实。

sentences.en: And when I hear it now, I, I really feel like how much I've, um, progressed since then.
sentences.zh: 现在重新听到它，我、我真的能感受到自己从那时起有了多大的、嗯，进步。

sentences.en: I mean, grief, grief always stays with you, but it sort of grows with you.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，悲伤、悲伤总是会伴随着你，但它会随着你一起成长。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: As you evolve over time.
sentences.zh: 随着你随着时间不断成熟。

sentences.en: And I feel like, um, I hear where I was in my voice, like, where I was in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，嗯，我在自己的声音里听出了我当时的状况，听出了我那一刻的处境。

sentences.en: So moving.
sentences.zh: 太感人了。

sentences.en: And by the way, just to say, like, we're so sorry for your loss.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我们对你的遭遇感到非常抱歉。

sentences.en: And we're so sorry for your loss and that, you know, that you had to go through that.
sentences.zh: 对于你经历这一切，我们感到非常遗憾和难过。

sentences.en: But thank you for sharing that moment back then at that time when it was so new and so fresh and raw.
sentences.zh: 但非常感谢你把当时那种那么新、那么新鲜且直白的情感分享出来。

sentences.en: The idea that you would be so generous to us to share that with us, like, as, as artists, I guess, we're putting stuff out in the world, hoping it connects with people.
sentences.zh: 你能对我们这么慷慨，把那些分享给我们，作为一个、作为艺术家，我想，我们把作品发布到世界上，是希望能和人们产生连接。
